best evident based input\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E65 years old female patient who is from nalgonda labor by occupation presented to OPD on ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 2 years back then she developed pedal edema, facial puffiness, decreased urine output short ness of breath and difficulty in moving lower limbs and was taken to a private hospital and diagnosed to have hypokalemic (k+2.2) and found to have raised creatinine levels and was started on conservative management\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1 year back patient started walking with support and pedal edema and facial puffiness and diagnosed with decreased urine output and diagnosed with CKD ( grade 3 RPD changes, increased creatinine, shrunken liver,anemia) and started with conservative management\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2months back pain abdomen, decreased appetite, burning micturition and cloudy urine for 6 days subsided on medication.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2days back pain abdomen - squeezing type not associated with loose stools\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EVomiting-assosiated with nausea and pain abdomen Non bilious ,non projectile, 2 episodes, food particles as consents
